periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the cranial midline
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a major axis roughly twice the length of the minor axis
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward taper with the geometric mass concentrated toward the anterior-inferior quadrant

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve along the posterior boundary of the dark region
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide band spanning approximately 45 percent of the visible torso length

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant gap approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna region
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular contour with no visible flattening

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, bushy black tail extending from the lower posterior, which is morphologically inconsistent with Ailuropoda melanoleuca
